Name: Jeshaiah, Son of Rehabiah
Summary: First of the sons of Rehabiah in the rest of the sons of Levi.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:21; 1 Chronicles 26:25: First of the sons of Rehabiah in the rest of the sons of Levi.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeshaiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
